title: SharePoint News: cross-post published news posts to Viva Engage communities and storylines
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap and tenant notice match its status and rollout dates, and Microsoft Learn supports the workflow, permissions and licensing qualifications. The changed storyline and setup pages still support the briefing; all four Learn citations opened successfully, and targeted searches found no documented cross-posting switch or storyline-creator configuration API.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no tenant-wide UI or API switch specifically for SharePoint News to Engage cross-posting.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint cross-post disable Engage tenant; SharePoint News Engage cross-posting disable tenant admin switch PowerShell Set-SPOTenant; Set-SPOTenant Engage cross. claims.claim: No documented API or automation operation sets the Specify storyline creators configuration.
